lines.say: A countdown appeared on your front door. Three days.
Nobody else has one. The neighbours stop saying hello.
So you quit your job. You call your mom. You eat cake for breakfast.
Last night. Doris throws you a party. The whole floor comes. Everybody cries.
Zero. The door beeps. A message. Your rent just went up by forty percent.
You already quit your job. What would you do? Write it in the comments.
